scope: Famous people tab before further name-history work; no new reviewed histories.
user_confirmed: Final fallback means famous people born on the selected calendar date.
selection: People born on the selected month/day, any name
outcome: All 9368 calendar memberships show five distinct people; 366 birthday pools contain eight candidates each. All 8677 profile identities and structured name-history facts are preserved. Exact namesakes exist for 2268 profiles, including 466 with local associations; birthday fallback is explicitly distinguished from namesakes.
claim_limits: Popularity scores and language counts are ranking proxies, not an objective fame judgment.
New local associations use birthplace within present-day borders; existing verified citizenship associations are retained separately by provenance.
Exact matches use real name labels; related forms are not eligible for the first two tiers. Labels alone do not prove a legal given name.
Birthday selection excludes incomplete dates, invalid dates, inconsistent years and years before 1000; it is not an exhaustive historical birthday register.
Localized labels remain incomplete; canonical names are used when a real translation is unavailable.
Filling five places does not mean finding five namesakes or verifying a name history.
